# Template library — every shipped template

<!-- Generated by frontend/tool/build_template_catalogue.dart from resources/templates.md. Do not edit by hand. -->

**2,349 templates** in the app, in 72 categories and 17 supergroups (catalogue version 1.0.0, specification §13.4).

Every template is ordinary template data (§11.3). It inherits the four groups every shipped template carries (§13.3), its category's context fields, and its record type's pack, then adds its own starter fields. Pick one from **Templates → Library**, search it by name, code, category, record type or field, and add it to a project as an editable copy: rename, retype, reorder, hide or change the requiredness of any field (§13.2).

Requiredness marks: `*` suggested REQUIRED, `+` suggested RECOMMENDED, unmarked OPTIONAL. A unit follows the type in brackets.

## Record types and their packs

Each template has one record type. The pack is the set of fields every template of that type shares; the guidance lines say how it is captured, what AI may do, what it produces and how it is reviewed.

### AGREEMENT — Agreement / approval

Kind `agreement` · 40 templates · identity: `agreement_reference`

`agreement_reference`* text · `agreement_title`* text · `first_party_name`* text · `second_party_name`+ text · `other_parties` long_text · `purpose`+ long_text · `terms`+ long_text · `effective_date`* date · `expiry_date`+ date · `agreement_status`+ choice · `approval_evidence`+ document_reference · `approved_by_name` text · `approval_date` date · `signatory_signature` signature

- **Capture:** Documents; manual entry; explicit acknowledgements
- **AI assistance:** Extract clauses and dates; compare with approved wording; prepare a source-grounded draft
- **Outputs:** Agreement draft; obligations register; signed-evidence index
- **Review:** Authorized signatory; legal review where applicable

### ASSESS — Assessment / analysis

Kind `assessment` · 214 templates · identity: `assessment_reference`

`assessment_reference`* text · `assessment_date`* date · `assessment_objective`* long_text · `criteria_reference`+ text · `evidence_items`+ document_reference · `findings`+ long_text · `assumptions` long_text · `risk_rating` choice · `review_conclusion`+ long_text · `assessor_name`+ text

- **Capture:** Documents; observations; photos; measurements
- **AI assistance:** Extract evidence; organize comparisons; calculate only with declared methods; propose review notes

- **Review:** Reviewer verifies evidence, assumptions and conclusions

Kind `visit` · 31 templates · identity: `visited_site_or_party`, `visit_date`

`visit_reference` text · `visit_date`* date · `visit_start_time`+ time · `visit_end_time` time · `visit_purpose`* long_text · `visited_site_or_party`* text · `visiting_team` long_text · `people_met` long_text · `observations`+ long_text · `discussion_notes` long_text · `agreed_actions`+ long_text · `next_visit_date` date

- **Capture:** Field forms; photos; explicit audio notes; optional GPS
- **AI assistance:** Transcribe notes; organize evidence; draft visit findings and follow-up
- **Outputs:** Visit report; photo appendix; action tracker
- **Review:** Field officer verifies observations and any attributed statements
